summary: WISeKey and SEALSQ established Quantisimo Corp., a SPAC-format special purpose vehicle, which signed a non-binding LOI with GigCapital8 Corp., a publicly traded SPAC, for a business combination. The proposed deal implies a pre-money enterprise value of ~$575 million, with a goal to reach $2 billion through build-up acquisitions of up to five additional quantum companies. Closing is expected in Q1 2027. The combined entity would be Nasdaq-listed as a 'Trusted Quantum Pure-Play' platform. The filing is a Form 6-K (press release) announcing the LOI; no board recommendation or financial advisor is named. Watch for definitive agreement negotiations, shareholder approvals, and regulatory timeline.
